summary.result: For many countries including South Korea, engaging in more active reduction activities through overseas reduction projects may be an important means of achieving the national reduction goal and contributing to global efforts to abate greenhouse gas emissions.
summary.background: With an aim to establish an analytical basis to assess the economic feasibility of each type of emission reduction project and to draw implications for the national strategy for implementing the reduction projects abroad, this study estimated mitigation cost ($/tCO₂) of 27 CDM projects in Peru.
summary.method: Despite its importance, research on the economic assessment of the emission reduction projects under the CDM has so far been scant.
